name: fluXtore Funnel Builder
author: fluXtore

sections.description:
fluXtore turns your WooCommerce store into a sales funnel builder. Instead of sending buyers through shop, cart and checkout, you design a short path: a landing page, a focused checkout (no cart step), offers shown at the right moment, and a thank-you page.

What you can build

  • Landing pages for one offer
  • Direct checkout pages, without passing through the cart
  • Order bumps: a small add-on on the checkout page (Pro)
  • One-click upsells and downsells after payment (Pro)
  • Custom thank-you pages
  • Conditional steps that send each visitor to the next page depending on their choice

What you can sell

Digital products, physical products, online courses, event tickets and services: anything you can sell with WooCommerce.

How it works

  1. Create a funnel from a ready-made template or from scratch.
  2. Add the steps you need: landing page, checkout, upsell, downsell, thank-you page.
  3. Design each page with the editor you already use.
  4. Publish and watch the numbers.

Works with your page builder

Elementor (the free version is enough, Elementor Pro is not required), the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg), Bricks, Divi and Oxygen 6 (beta).

Free and Pro

Free: up to 5 funnels, optimized templates for Elementor, checkout fields editor (show or hide fields, one or two columns, custom fields) and global analytics.

Pro: unlimited funnels, order bumps, one-click upsells and downsells, A/B split testing, per-funnel analytics (orders, revenue, visits, conversion rate, average order value, revenue per visit) and URL redirects. See the plans at https://fluxtore.com/pricing

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.4 or higher (self-hosted WordPress.org) and PHP 7.4 or higher
  • WooCommerce, active, with at least one product
  • An SSL certificate (HTTPS) for payments

Payments

Checkout and order bumps work with the payment gateways supported by WooCommerce. One-click upsells and downsells work with the PayPal and Stripe gateways of WooCommerce. If you use another gateway, contact support before you rely on one-click upsells.

Learn more

  • Documentation: https://fluxtore.com/docs
  • Guides and comparisons: https://fluxtore.com/blog
  • Support: https://fluxtore.com/tickets

External services

Ready-made templates. The free templates are included in the plugin: importing one does not contact any external service. Additional templates are provided by fluXtore Pro.

Facebook Pixel (optional). Only if you enter a Pixel ID in the settings, the plugin loads the Facebook Pixel and sends page views, checkout steps and purchases to Meta. With a consent plugin that supports the WP Consent API, it loads only after the visitor gives marketing consent. Meta terms: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms – Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

Google Analytics 4 (optional). Only if you enter a Measurement ID in the settings, the plugin loads Google Analytics and sends page views, checkout steps and purchases to Google. With a consent plugin that supports the WP Consent API, it loads only after the visitor gives statistics consent. Google terms: https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/terms/us/ – Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

fluXtore website. Links in the plugin open https://fluxtore.com (documentation, pricing, support). The Free plugin does not send your data to fluxtore.com. With the Pro plugin, activating a license and checking for updates send fluxtore.com the license key, the site address, the site name and the WordPress and PHP versions. Terms: https://fluxtore.com/terms – Privacy: https://fluxtore.com/privacy

Source code

The admin interface (assets/ui-beta/) is compiled with Vite from the readable source included in this plugin, folder admin-ui/src. To rebuild it: open the admin-ui folder, run npm install and then npm run build.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress go to Plugins, Add New, search for “fluXtore” and click Install Now, then Activate. (Or upload the plugin zip in Plugins, Add New, Upload Plugin.)
  2. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active, with at least one product.
  3. Open the fluXtore menu, go to Funnels, click Add New, pick a template and start editing.
  4. If you have a Pro license, install the Pro plugin, then go to fluXtore, Pro License, enter your key and click Activate.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. fluXtore works with the free version of Elementor, with the WordPress block editor, with Bricks, with Divi and with Oxygen 6 (beta).

Does fluXtore need WooCommerce?

Yes. fluXtore is built on top of WooCommerce, which must be installed and active with at least one product.

Does fluXtore work with my payment gateway?

Checkout and order bumps work with the gateways supported by WooCommerce. One-click upsells and downsells work with the PayPal and Stripe gateways of WooCommerce. For any other gateway, ask our support before you rely on one-click upsells.

What is the difference between Free and Pro?

Free lets you build up to 5 funnels with templates, a checkout fields editor and global analytics. Pro adds unlimited funnels, order bumps, one-click upsells and downsells, A/B split testing, per-funnel analytics and URL redirects. See https://fluxtore.com/pricing

How many sales funnels can I create with the free version?

Up to 5. Pro removes the limit.

Where do I buy the Pro version, and on how many sites can I use it?

At https://fluxtore.com/pricing. Each license covers a number of websites that depends on the plan: every WordPress installation counts as one.

What happens to my funnels if I delete the plugin?

By default your data is kept. In fluXtore, Settings, Advanced, you can choose to remove the plugin options, funnels and steps when the plugin is deleted. Deleting a funnel does not delete the WordPress pages of its steps.

Which themes does fluXtore work with?

It has been tested with Astra, Blocksy, Divi, GeneratePress, Hello Elementor, OceanWP, Bricks Builder and the default WordPress themes. Other themes may work too.

Can I share anonymized funnel benchmarks with fluXtore?

Yes. From Settings → Tracking → Funnel Benchmarks you can enable scheduled aggregation and opt in to anonymously share conversion benchmarks. When enabled, fluXtore records daily funnel metrics via WP-Cron, hashes any site-identifying data, and only stores aggregated step-level rates plus high-level product revenue ranges. You can disable either the schedule or data sharing at any time and all pending benchmark payloads will be cleared automatically.

Where can I get help?

Open a ticket at https://fluxtore.com/tickets or read the documentation at https://fluxtore.com/docs

Which payment gateways should I use?

We recommend Stripe and PayPal: the whole funnel (checkout, order bumps, upsell and downsell) is tested with them. Other payment methods work at the checkout, but upsells and downsells may need extra steps or may not be available.

Divi 5 says fluXtore is “potentially incompatible”. Does it work?

Yes. fluXtore’s Divi modules use the Divi 4 framework, which Divi 5 still runs. Your funnels work as usual on Divi 5; Divi simply lists plugins like this in its compatibility report. Modules built natively for Divi 5 are planned. In the Divi 5 editor the preview of a fluXtore button may not appear, but the settings open and the live page is not affected.
